description: Manage booking pages, appointments, team members and appointment types in YouCanBookMe.

youcanbookme_new_booking_trigger.description: Runs when new booking is observed in YouCanBookMe. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

youcanbookme_new_or_updated_booking_trig.description: Runs when new or updated booking is observed in YouCanBookMe. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.
